issues.claim: V09 deleted the `crisis.look.<kind>` catalogue family this round (VV1112-r2-14): each look is worded by its `crisis.looks` row's `label` (V11 §3.25.9), and V09's repair handed the change to V10. Three V10 sites still name the family: §1.2's V09 row (l. 202: 'V09 §4.21.12: `crisis.look.<kind>`, `info.crisis.*` … whose words the clerk renders'), T-V10-29 (l. 3097: 'every `info.damage.*`, `info.crisis.*` and `crisis.look.<kind>` key V10 §3.9a and V10 §3.9b (8) render' has a catalogue key in every shipped locale) and CVR-V10-22 (l. 3449). V10's own render path agrees with V09 (`LookAnswer.crises.looks[].says` is V09's `info.crisis.*` line, `{look}` the row's `label`), so nothing built changes; only a dependency row, a compile test's key list and a request row name a family that no longer exists.
issues.required_change: V10 l. 202 reads '(V09 §4.21.12: `info.crisis.*`, each look worded by its `crisis.looks` row's `label`, V11 §3.25.9)'. T-V10-29 drops 'and `crisis.look.<kind>`', reading 'every `info.damage.*` and `info.crisis.*` key V10 §3.9a and V10 §3.9b (8) render'. CVR-V10-22 reads 'the `info.crisis.*` and `info.damage.*` rows (each look's words its `crisis.looks` row's `label`, V11 §3.25.9)'.

issues.claim: R3-10 ends a disaster's ruined look building by building: once a Works other than a `decay` Works has begun on a building, V06 §3.22 (3)'s `crisisLookYields` is true and the look leaves that building. V03 §5.6 (4) (l. 2722–2734: a building draws the look only while 'not yet handed over'; `PlanDamage.level` falls to the own level, `PlanDamage.look` to null), V10 §3.9a (l. 1852–1855: 'each until its rebuilding Works begins') and §3.9b (8), §10.2 (f), §8.2 and V02 §5.7 (1) all take it. V09 decides by district alone: §4.21.13 (3) (l. 3668–3672: 'In a district a disaster look ruins, the plan panel … shows the building's lines at the look's `lookLevel` … under the head `info.crisis.ruinedFor`'), §4.21.12 (4) (l. 3604–3609) and §5.8 (l. 3952–3953) give 'a building in a district a disaster look ruins' the why card's 'For now: {look}, {condition}, weeks {a}–{b}' row, and §1b's and §2.12's damage-lines rows (l. 378, 1008) read the look's `lookLevel` 'over the look's `districts`'; row 92 and T-V9-86 test no building under its rebuild. So for a building of a struck district whose rebuild Works has begun — the normal path of the `reconstruction` condition that is the look's own source (R3-09) — V09 lists ruin lines at `lookLevel` and calls it ruined for now, while V03 draws its plan at its own level, V02 and §8.2 draw it under scaffolding and V10 tells the user the look has left it: two members, two outcomes for one case.
issues.required_change: V09 §4.21.13 (3): 'On a building a disaster look stands over — one of the look's `districts` (§11.2's `looks` reader), not yet handed over to a Works (V06 §3.22 (3)'s `crisisLookYields`, read through V03's `planDamage`: `PlanDamage.look` set; a preview never hands over) — the plan panel shows its lines at `PlanDamage.level` (the look's `lookLevel` by severity, or its own level where higher) under the head `info.crisis.ruinedFor`; once handed over it shows its own lines and head (V09 §4.21.13 (1))', the rest as it stands. V09 §4.21.12 (4) and §5.8: the `facts` row `info.crisis.ruinedFor` is given to 'a building a disaster look stands over (one of its `districts`, not yet handed over, V06 §3.22 (3); V03 §5.6 (4))'. §1b's and §2.12's damage-lines rows name `PlanDamage.look` as the input. §3.16 row 92 adds 'a building of a struck district whose rebuild Works has begun → its own level's lines and head, no `info.crisis.ruinedFor`'. T-V9-86 adds that clause on T-V3-40's (or T-V6-75's) fixture, a rebuild begun on one building of the district.

issues.claim: V09 §4.21.13 (1) (l. 3649–3651) glosses the damaged set as '§6.3 *Plan damage*'s comparison — an element shows damaged while the building's decay level is above 0 and at least its threshold t'. It omits §2.6 step 7's one case with no threshold (R3-05): while a building is `decayed` or `ruined`, every roof bay over a room of a wing whose `RoofSpec.kind` is `none` is damaged whatever its t. V10 §3.9a states the case (l. 1821–1822, and its kind row), and V03's `planDamage`, which V09's lines read, carries it (V03 §5.6 (2) (c)). For a roofless decayed wing below a bay's t, V09's text gives no `roofBay` line and V10's rows give one. Nothing built changes (V09's lines are V03's layer); only the gloss is narrower. Same omission as VDC3-02 at §6.3; one fix with it.
issues.required_change: V09 §4.21.13 (1), after '(a level of 0 damages nothing, so a never-decayed building draws its plan unchanged)': '; and, while the building is `decayed` or `ruined`, every roof bay over a room of a roofless wing (`RoofSpec.kind` `none`) whatever its threshold (§2.6 step 7)'.

issues.claim: R3-18 gives the creation week and the present at creation one name each, everywhere (§4.11 *The clock* (1), l. 8330–8334): the present at creation is the dossier's present week; the creation week is the `generate` event's week — that present, except on a history-first document, whose `generate` stands at the replay's start. V08 still calls the dossier's present week 'the creation week' at §3.16 (4) (l. 2420: 'It is the creation's week (§4.11 *The clock* (1)) and §2.9's `week` default'), W64 (l. 291: `presentWeek` feeds '§4.11's clock (the creation week; V08 §3.6 (3)'s `W₁`)') and the field table's present-week row (l. 672). A dossier with a history is a history-first creation (V08 §3.15), so there the two differ. The value fed is the right one; only the name is R3-18's other value. Same slip as VM-R3T-02's V08 end at §3.15 (l. 2318); one fix with it.
issues.required_change: In the three sites 'the creation week' / 'the creation's week' reads 'the present at creation (§4.11 *The clock* (1))'; §3.16 (4)'s sentence reads 'It is the present at creation (§4.11 *The clock* (1)) and §2.9's `week` default'.

issues.claim: V08 §2.4's field table is 'the one list' of what each dossier path feeds. Re-running round 2's script of each DR row's input cell against it finds four omissions left after VAH-r2-09's fix: `economicState.prosperity` (l. 647) omits DR27, whose inputs read '`wealth.label` (DR6)' (base l. 11964), as DR41's do, which the row names; `economicState.activeChains[]`, `.tradeDependencies[]`, `.customChains[]` (l. 652) omits DR27, whose inputs read 'the active reviewed custom chains (item 104 (b)) and `activeChains[]` (item 105 (i))'; `institutions[]` (l. 646) omits DR27, whose inputs read the institutions and 'a custom institution by its resolved scene archetype and `landmarkLevel`'; `customContentProvenance`, `customContentRoster` (l. 670) omits DR24, whose inputs read 'for a custom record, the inputs of item 104 (a)'s resolution — … admitted definition fields and keyword keys' (base l. 11961). The reverse direction finds nothing new; the DR rows are complete, so nothing built changes.
issues.required_change: In V08 §2.4's field table the feeds cells add: `economicState.prosperity` 'DR27'; `economicState.activeChains[]` … 'DR27 (the custom and active chains a sky fill carries)'; `institutions[]` 'DR27'; `customContentProvenance`, `customContentRoster` 'DR24 (a custom record's admitted definition fields)'.

V08 §3.16 (7) (b) (l. 2514) and V09 §4.21.12 (4) say 'V07's units'. V11 §3.25.9's `disaster` row (l. 4535: 'share of the districts — at THORP, HAMLET and VILLAGE of V07's ends') and its C-crisis-tables row (l. 4802), V10 §2.13's `LookAnswer.crises.looks[].districts` comment (l. 1014), V08 §3.17's combinations row (l. 2688) and §11.2's `LooksAnswer.crises[].districts` comment (base l. 16163), which V10 restates, say 'V07's ends'. Same slip VV12-r3-01 and VV12-r3-04 raised as behaviour at V02 and V03.
issues.required_change: V11 l. 4535 and l. 4802 read 'V07's units (V07 §5.6 (3): its ends, or an end-less thorp's toft groups)'. Second ends for the adjudicator: V10 l. 1014 and V08 l. 2688 read 'V07's units'; §11.2's `LooksAnswer.crises[].districts` comment (rendering) reads 'at the village rungs V07 §5.6 (3)'s units'.

issues.claim: T-V10-52 (l. 3120) carries, by R3-09 (e), 'a fire calamity naming a district with its linked `reconstruction` condition'. By V08 §3.16 (7) (b) and DR44 that condition carries `event` `calamity`, reads the `disaster` row and is look-bearing, so it is public at every key. The test's knowledge clause still enumerates 'at `public` every look-bearing condition — the siege, the refugee wave and the plague — is listed', which misses the fourth look its own fixture stands. A test written from the enumeration either misses the disaster look or fails on it; the clause's 'lists exactly §11.2's `looks` answer's crises' decides, so the enumeration only misstates it.

issues.claim: X-V12-5 (V12 l. 3406; destination V08 §7) asks for crisis fixtures with 'one week standing a siege, a quarantine and a refugee wave at once at CITY and at the METROPOLIS cap, their camped ground together past `densityCap`'. V12 §3.15.12 (l. 2686–2687) measures T122-6's share on that week, and repair-r3-V12 handed the clause to V08. V08 §7.1's fixtures sentence (l. 3188–3196), which defines the fixtures, lists them 'each standing through part of the year at its severity', with no shared week. A builder reading §7.1 alone may stagger them, leaving V12's density-cap case with no week. V08 cites X-V12-5 in the same sentence, so the request is one step away.
issues.required_change: V08 §7.1's fixtures sentence adds after 'each standing through part of the year at its severity': '— at `city-1` and `metropolis-3` with one week in which the siege, the plague's quarantine and the refugee wave stand at once, their camped ground together past `densityCap` (V12 §3.15.12's share)'.
